name: io.github.winnr-app/winnr-mcp
description: Manage cold email infrastructure from any AI assistant: buy and provision domains, create mailboxes, configure DNS, run email warming, read and reply to mail, and buy pre-warmed domains. Hosted with OAuth, or run locally.

environmentVariables.name: WINNR_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Winnr API token (starts with wnr_). Create one at https://app.winnr.app/mcp

environmentVariables.name: WINNR_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose read-only tools even when the token can write

environmentVariables.name: WINNR_NO_PURCHASES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to keep write access but hide every tool that charges the card
